senses.gloss: m. (אבץ. cmp. חָבַץ II, a. חבץ P. Sm. 1181 sq.) heavy pressure, overload, prostration from heavy load.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 19:2">Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 2</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 36b:10">B. Mets. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דהר</he> the prostration from carriyng a load up hill.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 78a:8">Ib. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>מתה מחמת א׳</he> died from fatigue.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:8">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite>. [Ar. reads <cite ref="A00657"><he>אוכצנא</he></cite>, cmp. Syr. <he>אכץ</he> P. Sm. 190—corr. acc.]
